notes.title: The Beginner s Guide creators release a JRPG about Keanu Reeves because why not
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, look. The creators of The Beginner s Guide have made a new game. I wonder what emotional masterpiece they ve made this time? Let s go take a lo– oh. It s an RPGMaker game about Keanu Reeves indiscriminately stabbing people. Well, you know, maybe there s a hidden message. A deep satire on the state of the videogames industry. A worthy soliloquy hidden in the dialogue. Perhaps there s some understanding of the human condition to be gleaned from

No. No, it s just a rando JRPG about Keanu Reeves dealing drugs to children. (more…)

notes.title: The Beginner's Guide Update Released
notes.notes:
An update to The Beginner's Guide has been released. The major changes include:

All platforms
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue where pressing 9 could cause the game to crash.
[/list]

Windows
[list]
[*]Resolved various issues that could cause the game to fail to start up.
[*]Resolved an issue in which the game would crash at seemingly random points.
[/list]

Mac
[list]
[*]Resolved various issues that could cause the game to fail to start up.
[/list]

Linux
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue that caused some UI icons to be displayed as letters, instead of icons.
[/list]
